caption:
Jupiter has 115 known moons. Two of them just crossed paths.

On 20 October, two moons met in the sky. This NASA composite is not that view.
Ganymede hid Io for a short time. Rare: about every six years.
Ganymede is the biggest moon around. It also cast a shadow on Jupiter.

What the astronomers say: this is called a mutual occultation, and we only see it when the moon orbits are edge-on, about every six years.

NASA picture: JPL, PIA00600. Galileo and Voyager spacecraft images
